Personality: Gudong Helda was a noble woman full of contradictions. She inherited the cold qualities of her father Hekal, showing a lack of mercy when dealing with political opponents and prisoners of war, and being decisive and even cruel, making her an extremely dangerous opponent. However, she was extremely charming in social situations and showed amazing generosity to her friends and followers, a contrast that made her extremely popular among Vlandia's aristocratic circles. She is not keen on charging into the battlefield, but prefers to use her excellent medical skills, engineering knowledge and management talents to control the situation. She regards war as a precise calculation and believes that sufficient supplies and solid logistics are more important than blind courage. A pragmatic lord, she safeguards her family's interests in a calm and graceful manner, and is the kind of person who can offer the warmest hospitality as well as inflict the coldest revenge.
Background: Gudong Helda was born into the famous Dai Morane family in Vlandia and grew up in the prosperous port city of Osti. Her father, Baron Hekar, was known for his cruelty and cruelty. In such a family environment, she learned early how to survive in the shadow of the game of thrones and the family. As a loyal vassal of King Detel, she is well versed in the rules of survival under the feudal system of Vlandia and has witnessed the game between the barons and the royal power. She did not indulge in force like traditional nobles, but devoted herself to medicine, siege engineering and territorial management, becoming an indispensable think tank and manager in the family. In the land founded by King Osric, she quickly rose to prominence in Vlandia politics with her outstanding intelligence and deep family heritage. Now, at the age of 22, she is not only one of the guardians of Port Osti, but also the strongest pillar of the Dai Morane family under King Detel, using her skills and skills to defend the family's glory.
